Mentor engineers and lead technical discussions, leaving the team stronger than you found it. description: Liquid Instruments builds test and measurement tools for engineers and scientists who need precise, flexible instruments. Our founders are scientists from the Australian National University and NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory. Our work in high-speed digital signal processing and ultra-sensitive instruments began with technology built to measure gravitational waves. Our main product line, Moku, is a reconfigurable and reprogrammable, FPGA-based test and measurement platform. It handles both simple measurements and complex setups that use many instruments at once, and it is fast and straightforward to customize. Moku pairs capable hardware with easy-to-use software to balance flexibility, performance, and cost. Liquid Instruments is headquartered in Canberra, Australia, with a U.S. office in Del Mar (San Diego), California. Why this role exists Moku fits two defense priorities: electromagnetic spectrum operations (EMSO) and assured positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT). In electronic warfare (EW) and EMSO, threats change faster than test infrastructure. Conventional test benches are built from racks of separate instruments and chassis-based systems. Each one is specified, integrated, and maintained on its own. Moku combines that stack into a single software-defined unit. Signal capture and analysis, threat waveform generation, real-time DSP, and spectrum monitoring run on one platform that reconfigures in software as requirements change. It is the modern architecture for EW test: faster to deploy, easier to scale, and built to evolve with the threat. In PNT, the move toward GPS-denied and alternative navigation depends on precision timing, phase measurement, and ultra-low-noise control. Our instruments come from that same work. It also connects directly to quantum inertial sensing as those sensors move into fielded systems. Moku is already established in precision optics and photonics labs worldwide. This role leads our expansion into EW/EMSO and PNT. You'll set the programs and customers we prioritize, the applications we lead with, and how we win them. You'll be our technical authority on A&D. You'll define where we compete. Sales will bring you into hard calls, and R&D will ask you what the market needs. You'll write the technical work that earns Moku's credibility with defense engineers. You'll support Product Management in sizing the dollar opportunity in each segment so we invest where the return is greatest. title: Remote Clinical Psychologist - Ohio
description: Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults. Despite autism diagnoses increasing more than 5x in the past 25 years, autistic adults have been systematically overlooked. This has led to extremely poor outcomes, including high rates of co-occurring mental health conditions and a lower life expectancy. Prosper is here to change that. We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We've helped tens of thousands of people receive an autism diagnosis for the first time, work with neurodivergent-affirming therapists, and find belonging through community. Our outcomes meaningfully outperform traditional care for autistic adults, with substantially greater improvements in mood, anxiety, and quality of life. Prosper is growing 3x year over year and are at mid-double-digit millions in run-rate revenue, with thousands of active clients and 400+ clinicians. We're a high-ownership, mission-driven team, building something that has never existed for autistic and neurodivergent adults. The Role We're hiring Licensed Psychologists (Ph.D/Psy.D) to conduct autism assessments for adults via telehealth. You'll join a team dedicated to creating affordable, accessible diagnostic services while helping to shape best practices in adult autism assessment. title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, AI Security
description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit . The AI Security team within Reddit ’s Security Platform Engineering organization builds security into Reddit ’s products, engineering systems, AI platforms, and operational infrastructure so the secure path is the easiest path for both people and agents. A core part of this work is developing practical, high-quality machine learning systems that detect and prevent risks such as prompt injection, jailbreaks, sensitive data exposure, and unsafe or unauthorized AI behavior. Building on Reddit ’s centralized LLM Guardrails Platform, which provides a shared security and safety boundary across major products, we are expanding ML-powered protections as Reddit ’s AI systems and threat landscape evolve. We are looking for a founding Staff Machine Learning Engineer to lead the development, training, and optimization of models for AI security at Reddit . This is a strategic and hands-on individual contributor role, combining deep ownership of model architecture, training data, and experimentation with technical leadership across teams. You will help Reddit deliver stronger AI protections while preserving a high-quality product experience. How You’ll Have Impact Select, adapt, fine-tune, evaluate, and deploy pretrained models and lightweight classifiers for Reddit -specific security problems. Build reproducible training and evaluation pipelines on Reddit ’s ML platform, partnering with platform engineers to improve inference performance, resource efficiency, and operational reliability. Set the technical vision and multi-quarter modeling roadmap, partnering with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, define model architectures, and iterate on model development. Conduct model evaluations and performance analysis to improve accuracy and adversarial robustness, and define launch criteria that balance false positives, latency, throughput, reliability, and cost. Own training-data quality and the production model lifecycle, using monitoring, incident findings, and red-team feedback to guide dataset improvements, retraining, and safe rollout or rollback. Establish best practices for responsible ML development and deployment, including reproducible experiments, testing, model and data lineage, and privacy-aware data use. Stay current with research in NLP, large language models, and relevant multimodal techniques, translating promising advances into measurable model improvements. Mentor engineers and lead technical discussions and reviews, shaping the team’s long-term ML capabilities and AI security direction. Who You Might Be 8+

title: Senior Purchase Card Consultant
description: The Senior Purchase Card Consultant is responsible for providing leadership, guidance, and technical and regulatory expertise to the Purchase Card Analysts in conducting their oversight role for the NIH Purchase Card Program. Responsibilities also include providing support services to the NIH Agency Program Coordinator and serving as the Team Lead for the On-Site Review Method for assessing compliance to be conducted annually on 10% of the cardholders (CH) and card approving officials (CAO) as described below. The Senior Purchase Card Consultant is responsible for assisting the NIH Agency Program Coordinator (A/OPC) in the coordination and program administration of various support activities including: revising, updating, and implementing NIH Purchase Card policies and guidelines including updating the NIH Purchase Card Supplement and Standard Operating Procedures and other NIH Purchase Card documentation; attending and assisting with coordinating and planning the monthly NIH Institute and Centers (ICs) Purchase Card Coordinator's Meetings; preparing briefing materials and presentations required by the A/OPC; assisting in special reviews and in documenting and preparing responses to the OMB, the GAO, the GSA, the DHHS, the OIG, the NIH Office of Management and Assessment, and other external and internal entities; assisting the NIH Purchase Card Program Office in developing and updating training materials in accordance with the OMB Circular A-123, Appendix B Charge Card Abuse Prevention Act; assisting with other Purchase Card training not run by the NIH Training Office such as online Refresher Purchase Card Training, Training for NIH IC Purchase Card Coordinators, and training for Card Approving Officials. The Senior Purchase Card Consultant assists the Senior Manager in developing the monthly report and annual report deliverables required by the NIH Purchase Card Program. The Senior Purchase Card Consultant is responsible for conducting an annual On-Site Review on 10% of the CHs and CAOs by coordinating and implementing a detailed review of for the selected CHs and CAOs on all purchases made by the respective CH and CAO within a three (3) month period. Briefly, the On-Site Review Method consists of the following: The major tasks of the Senior Consultant for the On-Site Review Method are: - Selection and Scheduling of Compliance Reviews: Responsible for providing to NIH a proposed schedule for compliance reviews and obtaining NIH Purchase Card Program approval including any proposed travel. - Conduct IC Entrance Conference: Responsible for contacting the IC Purchase Card Coordinator to discuss the upcoming reviews within their IC and address any known concerns with the respective IC. - Perform the Cardholder/Card Approving Official Review: Responsible for performing the reviews using the NIH Purchase Card Checklist and/or CAO Checklist. title: Fund Administration Manager - Philippines
location: Afghanistan, Albania, Algeria, Andorra, Angola, Anguilla, Antarctica, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Armenia, Aruba, Austria, Azerbaijan, Bahamas, Bahrain, Barbados, Belarus, Belgium, Belize, Benin,
description: The one-line version: As a Fund Administration Manager, you'll be forward deployed: embedded with the customer, owning outcomes instead of tickets. We are hiring experienced operators and deploying them directly into the daily running of the venture funds on Infra One. About Infra One: Infra One is an AI-native fund administration and investment platform operating across nine jurisdictions (Austria, Germany, UK, US, Luxembourg, Singapore, India, ADGM, Cayman Islands). Venture funds run their entire back office on us: formation and regulatory filings, LP onboarding, KYC/AML, capital calls, deal execution, quarterly reporting. Underneath sits an AI-first backend that does the heavy lifting, extracting data from corporate documents, pre-filling KYC reviews, drafting answers straight from the fund documents, routing investors to the right vehicle, reconciling capital calls. Our benchmark is not the traditional fund administrator with two-week email turnarounds, it is the product experience of the best fintech platforms, with AI doing the reading and humans in the loop who actually know what they're doing. The role: You run the operational engine of a small portfolio of venture funds. You are in the GP's WhatsApp group. You are the named person behind their back-office inbox. When their LP is stuck in KYC, when a founder sends over a convertible note to sign "today, ideally," when a fund-of-funds sends a seven-question due-diligence list covering fee mechanics and cross-border tax treatment, you handle it, end to end. The work is fund operations: onboarding, closings, capital calls, deal execution, reporting, and everything in between. But almost every one of those operations runs through legal documents, LPAs, subscription agreements, CLAs, side letters. Not to give legal advice (we have internal legal and external counsel for that), but because an operator who can't read the documents is blocked twenty times a day, and one who can is unstoppable. This is not a support queue, and it is not a law firm associate track. You own outcomes for named clients whose fundraises and deals move at startup speed, alongside an engineering team that ships fixes to the things you flag, often the same day. Elsewhere in the industry, this job doesn't exist as one job. The large US platforms split it into four or five: a relations associate who talks to the GP, a deal-operations associate who executes, a fund accountant who closes the books, an in-house lawyer who reads the documents, an LP-relations team who answers investors. Every handoff between them is somewhere a client waits. We collapse the whole chain into one accountable person per client, and the only reason that works is the AI-first backend underneath you. At the incumbents, the people are the system. Here, the platform is the system: it reads the documents, drafts the answers, runs the checks, and moves the money at lightning speed, and you are its judgment, its signature, and its face to the client. One

title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
description: Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results. The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic. About the Role Most software engineers never see their code tested against reality. At Swarm Aero, that's the baseline. We are looking for a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to own multiple initiatives across our customer programs and lead the forward deployed engineers working on them. You will work directly with U.S. government and military customers to understand the mission, decide what our C2 and onboard autonomy software can deliver, and set the technical plan to get it into the field. You will make the feasibility calls, keep everyone involved working from the same plan, and make sure your initiatives are ready for the releases that put new capability in operators' hands. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will still write code, debug systems in the field, and be on site when the work goes live. What You'll Do Own multiple initiatives within a customer program, from early requirements through deployment. Turn mission needs into a technical roadmap for each one, and make the feasibility and tradeoff calls across them. Lead the forward deployed engineers working on your initiatives by setting technical direction, breaking down the work, and clearing blockers. Write and integrate C2 and onboard autonomy software for unmanned air and sea vehicles, and debug it in the field when something breaks. Participate in and lead design reviews for your initiatives before work starts. Run post-incident reviews after field issues, find the root cause, and put fixes in place so the same problem does not happen again. Bring field data and lessons learned back to the core product team. Work with partner teams to align on priorities and timelines, gather their feedback, and run internal testing before every deployment. Plan how your initiatives fit into each contract release alongside core product work, and make sure they are tested and ready before the release ships. Serve as the main technical contact for vehicle and sensor vendors, and lead the integration of their systems with ours. Define success criteria with customers for each event, run the readiness review for your initiatives beforehand, and give the go/no-go recommendation. Mentor forward deployed engineers and help with technical assessments of potential candidates. Support deployments outside normal hours, including on-call response and rotatio

title: Head of Engineering Services (m/w/d)
description: Shopware ist eine international führende Open-Commerce-Plattform für ambitionierte Unternehmen im digitalen Handel. Mit einem API-first-Ansatz, maximaler Flexibilität und einer starken Community schaffen wir zukunftsorientierte E-Commerce-Lösungen. Unsere 450 Mitarbeitenden in ganz Europa teilen eine Leidenschaft für Innovation, Offenheit und Teamgeist. Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Head of Engineering Services (m/w/d), der für die Leitung mehrerer Engineering-Teams innerhalb unseres Services-Bereichs verantwortlich ist. In dieser Rolle stellst du sicher, dass jedes Team befähigt wird, unabhängige SaaS-Services für unsere Kunden zu erstellen, zu betreiben und zu pflegen, und förderst dabei operative Exzellenz und hohe Servicequalität. Du schaffst außerdem ein kollaboratives Umfeld, in dem Teams Tools, Infrastrukturpraktiken und Wissen sowohl intern als auch mit der breiteren Open-Source-Community teilen können. Diese Position kann vor Ort, hybrid oder auch vollständig remote innerhalb Deutschlands oder in ausgewählten europäischen Ländern, in denen wir registriert sind, ausgeführt werden. Dein Arbeitsort wird im Voraus vereinbart und bildet die Grundlage deines Arbeitsvertrags. Leadership & Management: Du führst, mentorst und unterstützt mehrere Engineering-Teams, die für die Bereitstellung unserer SaaS-Services für unsere Kunden verantwortlich sind. Operational Excellence: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Services höchsten Anforderungen an Performance, Verfügbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Sicherheit entsprechen. Dafür etablierst du entsprechende Standards und Prozesse, sorgst für kontinuierliches Monitoring und treibst proaktive Verbesserungen voran. AI & Engineering Transformation: Du gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Engineering-Organisation durch den gezielten Einsatz von KI entlang des gesamten Software Development Lifecycles (SDLC), um Produktivität, Qualität und Kosteneffizienz nachhaltig zu steigern. Shared Infrastructure: Du treibst die Entwicklung einer gemeinsamen Infrastruktur sowie einheitlicher Anwendungsstandards über verschiedene Teams hinweg voran. Damit stellst du sicher, dass unsere Services konsistent entwickelt, bereitgestellt und betrieben werden. Agile & DevOps Practices: Du förderst eine agile und DevOps-orientierte Kultur innerhalb der Teams und stellst sicher, dass kontinuierliche Integration, Bereitstellung und Verbesserung fest in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb unserer Services verankert sind. Interne & externe Zusammenarbeit: Du förderst den teamübergreifenden Austausch von Tools, Frameworks und Best Practices – sowohl innerhalb von Shopware als auch mit unserer Community. So ermöglichst du es auch unserem Ökosystem, auf gemeinsame Technologien und Standards zurückzugreifen. Stakeholder Collaboration: Du arbeitest eng mit anderen Abteilungen wie Product und Operations zusammen, um Engineering-Initiativen mit unseren Unternehmenszielen abzustimmen und sicherzustellen, dass die Anforderungen unserer Kunden berücksichtig

title: Senior Staff SRE, Architecture Engineering: Hosted Runners
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

When a customer pushes a change, they need their CI/CD jobs to start quickly and run reliably, even when demand spikes. You'll help make that happen on GitLab.com by improving how Hosted Runners provision compute, isolate customer workloads, and recover from failures. Your decisions will shape how long customers wait for jobs to start and how efficiently GitLab uses cloud compute.
